title: Torsion compatibility of finite-cover lower-shriek coefficients
statement: With the hypotheses of v1-finite-cover-lower-shriek-coefficient-compatibility, the invertible-order and primary torsion implications from F to K hold.

source.place: Tag 03SD, lemma-vanishing-easier, first paragraph (coefficient check implicit in descent to a summand); Tag 095R, lemma-finite-pushforward-constructible, and its finite etale case lemma-pushforward-constructible.

proof.text: Every stalk is annihilated by r because r is zero in ULift(ZMod r). The zero case follows from extension-by-zero restriction and preservation of zero by pullback and direct image. In the nonzero case, stalk conservativity and Bezout show that primary torsion forces p=r, while invertible-order torsion forces r to be invertible; exponent one then proves both conclusions for the finite-cover sheaf.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03SD, first paragraph; coefficient check written out from stalk annihilation and Bezout; constructibility follows the finite-etale local trivialization proof in lemma-pushforward-constructible.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoverLowerShriek_torsion {k : Type u}
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X U V : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    [Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] (v : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite v] [Etale v] :
    let R := ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)
    let F := (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) j).obj G
    let K := (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) j).obj
      ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) v).obj
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) v).obj G))
    (Scheme.IsTorsionSheafOfInvertibleOrder (Spec (.of k)) F →
      Scheme.IsTorsionSheafOfInvertibleOrder (Spec (.of k)) K) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p],
        Scheme.IsPrimaryTorsionSheaf R F p → Scheme.IsPrimaryTorsionSheaf R K p)
